about: Address patterns that open the same search on other sites. They are not APIs and they change, so they live here and nowhere else. Placeholders: {origin} {destination} {depart} {return}. 'airports' is 'all' where a comma-separated list is accepted and 'first' where only one code is. 'dates' is a strftime format. 'warning' is shown with the link whenever it is offered. 'why_first' marks the one site to check before the others and is the sentence shown with its link: a measurement, with the day it was made.

sites.name: Momondo
sites.why_first: On 8 Oct 2026 Momondo listed the same flights for less on 5 of 6 test routes. The two largest savings, $97 and $51, were on long trips.
sites.checked: 2026-10-08: a round trip and a round trip with airport lists both opened the right search. One way not checked.
